## 2B.4 Research Note: Narendra Modi in 2024

**Assessment:** I found **no direct 2024 evidence of Indian military operations** under Modi that would let me assess prisoner treatment, necessity, or proportionality in an operational sense. The best available evidence is **indirectly pro-civilian and restraint-oriented**: Modi repeatedly condemned harm to civilians in Ukraine and backed diplomacy. That is supportive of 2B.4, but it is not the same as a documented military-operations record.

| Title | Publisher | Date | URL | Claim-level summary | IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| [Prime Minister Narendra Modi speaks with President Zelenskyy](https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2015753&lang=2&reg=48) | Prime Minister’s Office / PIB | 20 Mar 2024 | https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2015753&lang=2&reg=48 | Modi called for dialogue and diplomacy and said India would support a peaceful solution. This shows a **civilian-protective, de-escalatory posture**, though it is not itself a military operation. | 2B.4, 2B.1, 1B.8 |
| [Prime Minister’s meeting with the President of Ukraine](https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2058086&lang=1&reg=3) | Prime Minister’s Office / PIB | 24 Sep 2024 | https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2058086&lang=1&reg=3 | Modi reiterated a “clear, consistent and constructive approach” in favor of peaceful resolution through diplomacy and dialogue. This supports a reading of **restraint and civilian concern**, not indiscriminate force. | 2B.4, 2B.1, 1B.1, 1B.8 |
| [Reuters report on Modi’s call with Putin after the children’s hospital strike](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/indias-modi-tells-putin-that-heart-bleeds-when-children-are-killed-3512452) | Reuters via Investing.com | 9 Jul 2024 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/indias-modi-tells-putin-that-heart-bleeds-when-children-are-killed-3512452 | Reuters reported Modi used civilian-protective language to rebuke Putin after a hospital strike. This is the clearest 2024 evidence that Modi publicly emphasized **civilian protection** and harm minimization. | 2B.4, 2B.1, 1B.8 |
| [India-Ukraine Joint Statement on the Visit of Prime Minister of India to Ukraine](https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2048245) | Prime Minister’s Office / PIB | 23 Aug 2024 | https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2048245 | The joint statement endorses a just and lasting peace based on dialogue, diplomacy, and international law. It supports the broader view that Modi’s 2024 posture was **pro-civilian and legality-oriented**, but it still does not document Indian battlefield conduct. | 2B.4, 2B.1, 1B.1, 1B.8 |
| [Potential India-Pakistan war signalled as Modi’s election rhetoric grows more worrying](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/asia-pacific/2024/05/21/potential-india-pakistan-war-signalled-as-modis-election-rhetoric-grows-more-worrying/) | The Irish Times | 21 May 2024 | https://www.irishtimes.com/world/asia-pacific/2024/05/21/potential-india-pakistan-war-signalled-as-modis-election-rhetoric-grows-more-worrying/ | The report says Modi mocked Pakistan’s nuclear capability in rally rhetoric. That is **negative contextual evidence** for discipline and proportionality norms, but it is campaign rhetoric, not a military operation. | 2B.4, 1B.2, 1B.5 |

### Search gap

- I found **no 2024 primary or Reuters-backed source** documenting Indian military operations where civilian protection, prisoner treatment, necessity, or proportionality could be directly evaluated.
- I also found **no evidence of a 2024 Indian military campaign** that would clearly implicate these IHL questions.
- So the best-supported conclusion is: **Modi’s public 2024 posture favored civilian protection and diplomacy, but the available record does not contain direct operational evidence for 2B.4.**
